KYPP_OWNER_SECRET.description: The passphrase you type on kypp's sign-in page when an agent connects. Make it long; anyone with it can read and write your memory.

CONSENT_SECRET.description: Signs sign-in and session state. 32 or more random characters: `openssl rand -hex 32`.
